title: SCAVS
author: Ben Jackson (as David Hunter)
description:
Two Lives Left

Welcome Operator. Your job is simple: choose your Scavenger. Guide them across a desolate alien planet, and help them find enough resources to justify an evac home.

Yours is the only voice they can hear – they’re depending on you to keep them safe. ‘System’ says your Scav is just a tool like any other. Resources are more important – the mission must always come first.

But find a quiet moment, and perhaps your Scavenger will open up. They might share their thoughts - a memory of home, or why they chose this life. You don’t have to listen; it doesn't matter to the mission. But it matters to them.

So, what kind of Operator will you be?

A choice-driven sci-fi adventure, with a parser-style open world to explore.

Content warning: Strong language (can be disabled), death, grief, and peril.
